lines: FirstClub's members get rewards in at least six places across the app.
Its one game, Toss and Win, sits in the Profile menu. For a new member, it opens to an empty screen with nothing to play.
This was a twenty-four hour design challenge, and my audit of the live app found the same pattern everywhere.
Nearly every reward asked members for something first, a toss can land on the losing side, and nothing gave people a reason to come back between orders.
No reason to come back tomorrow.
I compared four places for a daily reward on Home, and picked the one members already use.
A small wax seal appears on the gift icon only when there's one to open, and the old Toss and Win row still leads there.
The seal comes from FirstClub's own Approved stamp. Opening one takes a press and hold for under a second.
A ring fills, the seal cracks, and there's always something useful inside, with nothing to buy first and no countdown.
Instead of a streak that resets, any five seals in a week earn a Golden Seal, and members choose the gift.
Rewards then apply on their own in the cart, with nothing extra to unlock.
In a day, I delivered the audit, the main flow, nine edge cases and a clickable prototype, built with AI.
It isn't built, so next I'd test the hold with members and measure orders against a holdout group.
Most of the work was finding what the app already had, and connecting it.
